description: Update an existing Data Security Setting in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_data_security_setting afterwards to see the updated record.

alertSeverityId.description: The severity of the alerts raised. The project's most severe when empty.

allowedValues.description: Values that are never findings, such as your own support address.

contentScanIntervalInHours.description: How often a store's content is sampled again.

declareIncidentsForCriticalIssues.description: Declare an incident, which runs your incident process, when a Critical issue opens.

disabledDataTypeIds.description: Built-in data types the project's scans do not look for.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Data Security Setting to update. Required. Use list_data_security_settings to find IDs.

incidentSeverityId.description: The severity of the incidents declared. The project's most severe when empty.

isConfigurationScanEnabled.description: Read stores' configuration and access, and run the checks.

isContentScanEnabled.description: Sample stores' content for sensitive data, where the content permission was granted.

isTelemetryScanEnabled.description: Sample the project's logs, traces, exceptions, replays and AI conversations for sensitive data.

keepMaskedSamples.description: Keep up to three masked samples with each finding. Off keeps counts only.

maxBytesPerObject.description: The most bytes read from one object.

maxBytesPerScan.description: The most bytes one content scan reads in all.

maxObjectsPerScan.description: The most objects one content scan of a bucket reads.

maxRowsPerTable.description: The most rows read from one table.

maxTablesPerScan.description: The most tables one database scan reads.

notifyOwners.description: Tell a store's owners when an issue opens on it.

openCasesForCriticalIssues.description: Open a security case, grouped by store, when a Critical issue opens.

raiseAlertsForCriticalIssues.description: Raise an alert, which pages whoever is on call, when a Critical issue opens.

telemetrySampleSize.description: How many recent records of each service and signal a telemetry scan reads.

name: update_data_security_setting
title: Update Data Security Setting
